changeSet.author: TDuric
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[Allocation]( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_uid] DEFAULT (newid()) NOT NULL, [ScoreType] [int] NOT NULL, [AssetTypeUid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [OverrideName] [nvarchar](250) NULL, [State] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_State] DEFAULT (1) NOT NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_CreatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_CreatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [UpdatedOn] [datetime] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_UpdatedOn] DEFAULT (getutcdate()) NOT NULL, [UpdatedBy] [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_UpdatedBy] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [IsExternallyCalculated] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_IsExternallyCalculated] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricAllocation] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetTypeUid] ASC, [ScoreType] ASC ) ) END
IF COL_LENGTH('metrics.Allocation', 'LowerThreshold') IS NULL BEGIN alter table [metrics].[Allocation] add LowerThreshold [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_LowerThreshold] DEFAULT(50) NOT NULL END
IF COL_LENGTH('metrics.Allocation', 'UpperThreshold') IS NULL BEGIN alter table [metrics].[Allocation] add UpperThreshold [int] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAllocation_UpperThreshold] DEFAULT(90) NOT NULL END
changeSet.rollback:
SELECT 1 FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'metrics.Allocation') AND name = 'DF_MetricAllocation_LowerThreshold'
SELECT 1 FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'metrics.Allocation') AND name = 'DF_MetricAllocation_LowerThreshold' BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_LowerThreshold END
SELECT 1 FROM sys.default_constraints WHERE parent_object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'metrics.Allocation') AND name = 'DF_MetricAllocation_UpperThreshold' BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT DF_MetricAllocation_UpperThreshold END
IF COL_LENGTH('metrics.Allocation', 'LowerThreshold') IS NOT NULL BEGIN alter table [metrics].[Allocation] drop column LowerThreshold END
IF COL_LENGTH('metrics.Allocation', 'UpperThreshold') IS NOT NULL BEGIN alter table [metrics].[Allocation] drop column UpperThreshold END

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricAllocation') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAllocation WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ADD CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAllocation PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ) end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' and CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'UQ_MetricsAllocation') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ADD CONSTRAINT UQ_MetricsAllocation UNIQUE (AssetTypeUid, ScoreType, OverrideName ); end
if not exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAllocation') begin CREATE CLUSTERED INDEX CIX_MetricsAllocation ON metrics.Allocation ( AssetTypeUid ) end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation' and COLUMN_NAME = 'CalculationMethod') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ADD CalculationMethod int constraint DF_MetricsAllocation_CalculationMethod default(4) not null end
if not exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsThresholdBased') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ADD IsThresholdBased bit constraint DF_MetricsAllocation_IsThresholdBased default(0) not null end
changeSet.rollback:
if exists (select 1 from [sys].[key_constraints] where name = 'PK_MetricAllocation') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAllocation WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] ADD CONSTRAINT PK_MetricAllocation PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [AssetTypeUid] ASC, [ScoreType] ASC ) end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[TABLE_CONSTRAINTS] where CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'UNIQUE' and CONSTRAINT_NAME = 'UQ_MetricsAllocation') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT UQ_MetricsAllocation end
if exists (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'CIX_MetricsAllocation') begin DROP INDEX [CIX_MetricsAllocation] ON [metrics].[Allocation] WITH ( ONLINE = OFF ) end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation' and COLUMN_NAME = 'CalculationMethod') begin if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where name = 'DF_MetricsAllocation_CalculationMethod') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsAllocation_CalculationMethod] end ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP COLUMN CalculationMethod end
if exists (select * from [INFORMATION_SCHEMA].[COLUMNS] where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' and TABLE_NAME = 'Allocation' and COLUMN_NAME = 'IsThresholdBased') begin if exists (select * from [sys].[default_constraints] where name = 'DF_MetricsAllocation_IsThresholdBased') begin ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricsAllocation_IsThresholdBased] end ALTER TABLE [metrics].[Allocation] DROP COLUMN IsThresholdBased end
